Method of Attack: Downgrade the connection's security by truncating the extension negotiation message (RFC8308) from the transcript
Using less secure client authentication algorithms
Deactivating specific countermeasures against keystroke timing attacks
Impacted Systems: SSH client and server implementations such as OpenSSH, Paramiko, PuTTY, KiTTY, WinSCP, libssh, libssh2, AsyncSSH, FileZilla, Dropbear
Attack Vector: Active adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) position with the ability to intercept and modify the connection's traffic at the TCP/IP layer
